# BNL Community Fixes v2.4.6

Replay system fixes and damage/healing indicator improvement.

## Changes
- Fixed ESC menu opening and immediately closing during replay.
- Fixed exit button in ESC menu not closing the game during replay.
- Chat is now hidden by default in replay; press Enter to toggle it.
- 
- 
- Smoother unit rotation playback using quaternion slerp sampling.
- Suppressed locomotion animation while player is in building state during replay.
- Fixed false full-health heal number appearing on screen every time a player spawns.
